name: prompt-tools
description: Rewrites a typed prompt with Haiku and appends saved text to it.

rewrite.title: Rewrite
rewrite.description: Rewrites each typed prompt with Haiku.

apply.title: Apply rewrite
apply.description: dialog: asks which prompt to send. direct: sends the rewrite.

style.title: Rewrite style
style.description: fix wording: makes the prompt clear. expand: makes it a brief with Goal, Constraints, Done when.

append.title: Append
append.description: Text added to the end of each typed prompt. Empty adds nothing.
